atlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game sprite parts atlas.
Make an EXTREMELY LOW RESOLUTION block-pixel soccer ragdoll atlas. Canvas 1536x1024, exact 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512x512 invisible cells. Six isolated upright sprite parts, one at each cell center, generous transparent gaps. Layout strictly: top left torso, top middle head, top right left arm; bottom left right arm, bottom middle left leg, bottom right right leg. NO labels or grid.
Visual style is tiny primitive retro game sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor, NOT detailed modern pixel art. Every visible block is large and crisp, only about 4-10 logical pixels across each object. All edges square, 90-degree hard steps, flat colors, NO heavy outline, NO gradients, NO texture, NO anti-aliasing.
Torso: broad solid medium-blue square shirt, 8 blocks wide and 8 blocks tall; absolutely NO sleeves attached, NO collar, NO neck cutout, NO stripes, NO details, NO numbers, NO highlights. Torso pure rectangular square.
Head: tiny rectangular golden skin head, 4 blocks wide and 5 blocks tall, simple dark-brown rectangular hair stripe across top only. One white square face highlight allowed. NO eye outlines, NO nose, NO ears, NO mouth, NO detailed face. Head is about HALF width of torso.
Arms: narrow straight vertical golden rectangular sticks, 2 blocks wide x 7 blocks tall. Blue short sleeve rectangle at top two blocks. No shoulder anatomy, no elbow bulge, no separate hand shape, no muscles. Both arms visually identical.
Legs: VERY SHORT stubby vertical pieces, 2 blocks wide x 4 blocks tall, blue shorts at top block, white sock next block, black block boot bottom two blocks. Black boot can extend one block to right, but no other details. Both legs visually identical.
Relative object sizes across the whole sheet: torso 280x280, head 140x150, arms 76x222, legs 76x140. All object centers exactly at cell centers. The style should feel absurdly simple, like soccer game figures drawn using only a handful of rectangles. True transparent empty canvas, no scene, no floor, no shadows, no halos.
ball:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent football game sprite.
Generate ONE small flat pixel art soccer ball centered on a truly transparent 1024x1024 canvas. White round stepped silhouette made from about 12x12 large logical square pixels, enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Ball fills about 60% of canvas width. Round means the bounding shape is a clearly circular staircase, not a square: few blocks across top and bottom, widest through the middle. A few bold black panel patches, one roughly central black patch and a few at the edges, white between them. Slight light-grey pixel blocks only at lower-right inside ball for simple shading. Looks like a tiny very low-resolution arcade soccer video game ball from the 1980s. Use only white, black, light grey. No thin pixel details, no realistic leather seams, no soft lighting, no gradients, no text, no floor, no ground shadow, no halo. Crisp hard square pixel edges, all blocks aligned in the same coarse grid.
